name: Strong Soul

other: Race/region: dwarf (Oldonnar), elf (Elven Court or Silverymoon), gnome (the Northdark or the Western Heartlands), half-elf (Dambrath, the Dalelands, or Silverymoon), halfling (Channath Vale or Luiren), or human (the Moonshae Isles). Lyra qualifies as a half-elf of Dambrath, the Dalelands, or Silverymoon.
Regional feat slot — may only be selected as a 1st-level character, and a character may have only one regional feat.

benefit: +1 bonus on Fortitude and Will saves, reflecting an innate resistance to fell magic and supernatural attacks that make the soul hard to separate from the body. That bonus rises to +3 specifically against death effects, energy drain, and ability drain.
note: Source corrected (Aug 2026): not Player's Handbook II as src/data/feats/strong_soul.json's "source: PHB" and this project's earlier guess both assumed — Rae confirmed it's a Player's Guide to Faerûn regional feat, gifted to the whole party as a 1st-level bonus feat, and supplied the printed text directly. Page number still unconfirmed: this book's PDF has no real text layer (CHOCR/OCR only, per the existing note on players-guide-to-faerun.json's spell file), and the character-level OCR markup made a targeted page search impractical, so page is left null rather than guessed. The +1/+3 split here resolves the earlier discrepancy: CLAUDE.md's own derived stat block (Fort +8, Will +12) already used +1 as the flat Strong Soul bonus, so that math was right all along — the bug is isolated to src/data/feats/strong_soul.json, which currently codes a flat +2/+2 instead of +1 normally (+3 vs. death effects/energy drain/ability drain specifically). Not fixed here since that's a live calc-engine file outside this extraction pass — flagging for a follow-up edit.

name: Initiate of Nature

other: Patron deity Eldath, Mielikki, or Silvanus

benefit: You can rebuke or command animals or plant creatures the way an evil cleric rebukes or commands undead, usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. You may also add the following spells to your cleric or druid spell list: 3rd — Mold Touch; 4th — Briartangle, Thorn Spray; 5th — Fireward, Tree Healing.
note: Page not cited by Rae and not independently located — this book's PDF has no real text layer (see the Strong Soul entry above), so page is left null rather than guessed. Of the five granted spells, only Fireward is currently in the spell library (players-guide-to-faerun.json and spell-compendium.json both have it at Drd 5, matching the level granted here). Mold Touch, Briartangle, Thorn Spray, and Tree Healing aren't in any data/spells/*.json file yet — none were among the 9 entries in the curated Player's Guide to Faerun Druid Spell Descriptions.pdf used earlier, so they'd need their own extraction pass (page citations and all) before Lyra could take this feat and use them.
